text: Step 1 shipped to main: the engine now records raw SX live scores/status/odds frames (sxlive journal, archived to the cloud-archive Release). It takes effect when the engine next restarts (next handover, up to ~6 h). Step 2 (the SX live feed itself) needs those real frames first, so it waits on that data; I'll build it from them rather than guess. Not building live betting on guessed formats.
